cookie.label: Login Cookie
cookie.description: The full cookie header of a logged-in music.youtube.com session of an account with YouTube Music Premium. Open the browser's developer tools, pick any request to music.youtube.com in the Network tab and copy the value of its Cookie request header.

high_quality.label: Premium audio quality
high_quality.description: Stream the 256 kbps formats. With this off, the best standard format (about 160 kbps Opus) is used.

include_videos_in_search.label: Include videos in search results
include_videos_in_search.description: Search YouTube Music videos as well as songs, including covers, remixes and live performances. This does not change radio or library imports.

report_plays.label: Add played songs to the YouTube Music history
report_plays.description: Report songs you listened to for at least 30 seconds, like the YouTube Music app does. This keeps your history and recommendations up to date.

keep_session_alive.label: Keep the session alive
keep_session_alive.description: Refresh the session cookies every 10 minutes, like an open YouTube tab does, so the login does not expire. Only turn this on for a cookie nothing else uses, for example one from a browser window you closed right after copying it.

errors.cookies_expired: Your YouTube Music session has expired. Reconfigure this provider with a fresh cookie.
errors.invalid_cookie: The cookie has no SAPISID. Copy the full cookie header of a request to music.youtube.com while you are logged in.
errors.no_javascript_engine: The embedded JavaScript engine (mini-racer) is not available on this system, so stream URLs can not be solved.
errors.premium_required: This provider needs a YouTube Music Premium subscription, and the account of this cookie has none.
errors.premium_check_failed: Could not check whether the account has YouTube Music Premium. Try again later.

manifest.description: Stream songs, albums, playlists and podcasts from YouTube Music Premium through its own web API, without ytmusicapi, yt-dlp or a PO token server.
